tex_content.html: \begin{example} \end{example}[Nonunique tangent and asymptotic limits] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0419, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0420 1. appG:G.24,appG:G.28\group Metric cones Connected compact spaces can have two nonisometric tangent-type limits along different blow-up sequences; connected noncompact planar subspaces can likewise have two nonisometric asymptotic limits. These exercises show that existence and uniqueness in the definitions are genuine hypotheses. \end{example}
